entities.name: Pantothenate synthetase
observations: The 303-residue query sequence is an exact sequence match to reviewed UniProt protein Q1M4A1 from Rhizobium johnstonii.
Catalyzes ATP-dependent condensation of (R)-pantoate and beta-alanine through a pantoyl-adenylate intermediate.
Assigned EC 6.3.2.1 and Rhea reaction RHEA:10912.
Annotated as a homodimeric cytosolic enzyme.
Belongs to the Pantoate_ligase Pfam family PF02569.22, detected across positions 3–277.
Participates in the final step of (R)-pantothenate biosynthesis.

entities.name: Pantothenate biosynthesis
observations: Pantothenate synthetase catalyzes the terminal biosynthetic step: (R)-pantoate plus beta-alanine plus ATP yields (R)-pantothenate plus AMP and diphosphate.
The pathway supplies pantothenate, precursor to coenzyme A and 4'-phosphopantetheine.

entities.name: Pantothenate synthetase sequence properties
observations: Query length is 303 amino acids; calculated molecular mass is 33,078.7 Da; theoretical pI is 6.46.
Sequence-derived charge at pH 7 is approximately -1.1; these are unmodified-protein estimates.
